title: MisarMail
description: Full email marketing platform: inbox, campaigns, contacts, templates, and analytics via MCP.
summary: Full email marketing platform: inbox, campaigns, contacts, templates, and analytics via MCP.
offersHint: Full email marketing platform: inbox, campaigns, contacts, templates, and analytics via MCP. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mail.misar.io/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: send_email
toolsPreview.description: Send a transactional email from a verified MisarMail account. `from.email` must match an email account you have already verified — use list_domains to check which sender domains are available. Returns the message ID and queue status.

toolsPreview.name: list_emails
toolsPreview.description: List emails from a mailbox folder with optional full-text search across subject and body. Use this for reading the unified inbox; use list_campaigns for marketing sends.

toolsPreview.name: get_email
toolsPreview.description: Read the full content of a single email by ID, including headers, body, and attachments metadata. Side effect: marks the email as read.

toolsPreview.name: reply_to_email
toolsPreview.description: Reply to an existing email thread. The sender address and threading headers are derived from the original message, so only the body is required.

toolsPreview.name: archive_email
toolsPreview.description: Move an email to the archive folder. Reversible — the message is not deleted.

toolsPreview.name: validate_email
toolsPreview.description: Validate an email address before sending: syntax, MX records, disposable-domain and role-account detection. Use this to protect sender reputation on imported lists.

toolsPreview.name: list_campaigns
toolsPreview.description: List email marketing campaigns with their status, audience size, and headline metrics. Filter by status to find drafts ready to send or campaigns still sending.

toolsPreview.name: get_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for one campaign: content, audience segment, schedule, and delivery statistics (sent, opened, clicked, bounced, complained).

toolsPreview.name: create_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Create a new email marketing campaign as a draft. Creating never sends — call send_campaign separately once the content and audience are confirmed.

toolsPreview.name: send_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Send a campaign now, or schedule it for a future time by passing scheduled_at. This delivers real email to real recipients and cannot be undone once sending starts — confirm the audience with get_campaign first.

toolsPreview.name: list_contacts
toolsPreview.description: List contacts with their subscription status and engagement metrics. Filter by status to find unsubscribed or bounced addresses that should be excluded from sends.

toolsPreview.name: create_contact
toolsPreview.description: Add a single contact. Adding a contact records consent to email them — only add addresses that opted in, or the send will damage sender reputation and may breach CAN-SPAM/GDPR.

toolsPreview.name: update_contact
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing contact by email address, including changing subscription status. Setting status to unsubscribed immediately excludes them from every future campaign.

toolsPreview.name: import_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Bulk-import up to 5,000 contacts in one call. Existing addresses are updated rather than duplicated. Returns per-row results so you can see which rows were rejected and why.

toolsPreview.name: get_contact_score
toolsPreview.description: Get engagement score, engagement tier, and churn risk for one contact — or the lowest-engagement contacts across the list when contact_id is omitted. Use before a re-engagement campaign.

toolsPreview.name: list_templates
toolsPreview.description: List saved email templates with their variable placeholders, so you can pick one for a campaign or transactional send.

toolsPreview.name: create_template
toolsPreview.description: Create a reusable email template. Use {{variable}} placeholders for personalisation — they are substituted at send time and previewable via render_template.

toolsPreview.name: render_template
toolsPreview.description: Render a template with sample variables and return the resulting HTML and subject. Use this to preview personalisation before sending anything.

toolsPreview.name: list_automations
toolsPreview.description: List automation workflows (welcome series, re-engagement, drip sequences) with their trigger type and active state.

toolsPreview.name: get_automation
toolsPreview.description: Get one automation workflow in full: trigger, every step with its delay, and per-step completion stats.

toolsPreview.name: create_automation
toolsPreview.description: Create an automation workflow from a trigger and an ordered list of steps. Created paused by default — call toggle_automation to activate once the steps are reviewed.

toolsPreview.name: toggle_automation
toolsPreview.description: Activate or pause an automation. Activating starts enrolling contacts and sending on the configured schedule.

toolsPreview.name: list_ab_tests
toolsPreview.description: List A/B tests with per-variant results and whether a winner has been selected yet.

toolsPreview.name: create_ab_test
toolsPreview.description: Create an A/B test on a campaign with two or more variants. A sample percentage is sent first; the winner goes to the remainder once selected.

toolsPreview.name: select_ab_test_winner
toolsPreview.description: Select the winning variant and send it to the remaining audience. This triggers a real send to everyone who was held back — it cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: get_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Get delivery and engagement analytics — sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, and complained — for the account or one campaign, grouped by day/week/month.

toolsPreview.name: generate_report
toolsPreview.description: Generate a structured analytics report over a date range. Report types: campaign_performance, engagement_funnel, cohort_analysis, and send_time_heatmap (best hour/day to send).

toolsPreview.name: get_revenue_attribution
toolsPreview.description: Attribute ecommerce revenue to email — revenue per campaign, per contact, and average order value from tracked conversions.

toolsPreview.name: get_monetization_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get newsletter monetization stats: paid subscribers, MRR, churn, and sponsorship revenue for the period.

toolsPreview.name: get_deliverability_score
toolsPreview.description: Get the account deliverability score (0–100) and letter grade (A–F) with the factors dragging it down. Start here when asked why emails are landing in spam.

toolsPreview.name: run_deliverability_audit
toolsPreview.description: Run a full deliverability audit across authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), domain reputation, list hygiene, content signals, and blocklist status. Returns prioritized findings.

toolsPreview.name: get_warmup_status
toolsPreview.description: Get IP/domain warm-up progress and today's remaining send capacity. Exceeding warm-up capacity on a new domain is the fastest way to get throttled or blocklisted.

toolsPreview.name: check_dmarc
toolsPreview.description: Check live SPF, DKIM, and DMARC DNS records for a domain and report alignment problems with the exact record to publish. Works for any domain, not only your own.

toolsPreview.name: list_domains
toolsPreview.description: List sending domains with verification status and their DKIM/SPF/DMARC records. Check here first when a send fails with an unverified-sender error.

toolsPreview.name: add_domain
toolsPreview.description: Add a sending domain and return the DNS records to publish. The domain cannot send until those records are live and verify_domain succeeds.

toolsPreview.name: verify_domain
toolsPreview.description: Re-check a domain's DNS records and mark it verified if they resolve. Safe to retry — DNS propagation can take up to 48 hours.

toolsPreview.name: configure_inbound_domain
toolsPreview.description: Configure inbound email routing for a subdomain so replies land in the MisarMail unified inbox. Returns the MX record to publish.

toolsPreview.name: list_forms
toolsPreview.description: List signup forms with their embed status and conversion counts.

toolsPreview.name: get_form
toolsPreview.description: Get one signup form including its fields, embed code, and redirect behaviour.

toolsPreview.name: get_form_submissions
toolsPreview.description: List submissions for a signup form, including the submitted field values and timestamps.

toolsPreview.name: create_landing_page
toolsPreview.description: Create a hosted landing page with an email capture form. Returns the public URL; subscribers flow straight into your contact list.

toolsPreview.name: list_marketplace_items
toolsPreview.description: Browse the MisarMail template marketplace for ready-made email and automation templates.

toolsPreview.name: get_marketplace_item
toolsPreview.description: Get one marketplace listing with its full preview, author, and install count.

toolsPreview.name: list_inbox_conversations
toolsPreview.description: List unified-inbox conversations (threads) with their status and detected intent. Use this for triage; use list_emails for individual messages in a folder.

toolsPreview.name: get_inbox_conversation_messages
toolsPreview.description: Get every message in one inbox conversation, oldest first, with sender and timestamps.

toolsPreview.name: categorize_inbox_emails
toolsPreview.description: Run AI categorisation over a batch of inbox emails to label intent and priority. Consumes AI credits — pass only the emails you actually need triaged.

toolsPreview.name: list_api_keys
toolsPreview.description: List API keys on the account with their scopes and last-used time. Key secrets are never returned — only metadata.

toolsPreview.name: generate_subject_lines
toolsPreview.description: Generate AI subject-line variants for a campaign topic, optionally tuned to a tone and audience. Good input for create_ab_test.

toolsPreview.name: list_integrations
toolsPreview.description: List connected third-party integrations and their sync status.

toolsPreview.name: get_integration
toolsPreview.description: Get one integration's configuration, scopes, and last sync result.

toolsPreview.name: toggle_integration
toolsPreview.description: Enable or disable an integration. Disabling stops all syncing but preserves the stored credentials.

toolsPreview.name: list_sandbox_sends
toolsPreview.description: List emails captured by sandbox mode. Sandbox intercepts sends instead of delivering them — use it to verify templates and automations without emailing anyone.

toolsPreview.name: clear_sandbox
toolsPreview.description: Delete every captured sandbox email. Affects only intercepted test messages, never real sent mail.

toolsPreview.name: upgrade
toolsPreview.description: Show the current MisarMail plan, how much of each quota is left, and what upgrading unlocks. Call it any time — not only after hitting a limit. Set open=true to open the checkout page in the default browser.
